num.J_Dz(e): Balaban-like index from Barysz matrix weighted by Sanderson electronegativity
num.F04[C-N]: Frequency of C-N at topological distance 4
num.NssssC: Number of atoms of type ssssC
num.F03[C-N]: Frequency of C-N at topological distance 3
num.HyWi_B(m): Hyper-Wiener-like index (log function) from Burden matrix weighted by mass
num.SM6_L: Spectral moment of order 6 from Laplace matrix
num.F03[C-O]: Frequency of C - O at topological distance 3
num.Me: Mean atomic Sanderson electronegativity (scaled on Carbon atom)
num.Mi: Mean first ionization potential (scaled on Carbon atom)
num.SpPosA_B(p): Normalized spectral positive sum from Burden matrix weighted by polarizability
num.SpMax_A: Leading eigenvalue from adjacency matrix (Lovasz-Pelikan index)
num.TI2_L: Second Mohar index from Laplace matrix
num.F02[C-N]: Frequency of C - N at topological distance 2
num.SpMax_B(m): Leading eigenvalue from Burden matrix weighted by mass
num.Psi_i_A: Intrinsic state pseudoconnectivity index - type S average
num.SM6_B(m): Spectral moment of order 6 from Burden matrix weighted by mass

cat.F01[N-N]: Frequency of N-N at topological distance 1
cat.B01[C-Br]: Presence/absence of C - Br at topological distance 1
cat.B03[C-Cl]: Presence/absence of C - Cl at topological distance 3
cat.B04[C-Br]: Presence/absence of C - Br at topological distance 4
cat.nHDon: Number of donor atoms for H-bonds (N and O)
